chapter_title: Export Oriented Units (EOUs), Electronics Hardware Technology Parks (EHTPs), Software Technology Parks (STPs) and Bio-Technology
title: Repair / Remaking of Jewellery
text: 6.05 Repair / Remaking of Jewellery EOUs may import plain / studded gold / platinum or silver jewellery for export after repairs /remaking.
intent: Provide knowledge guidance for Repair / Remaking of Jewellery.
